terra.problem: The lesson about saying the right words but not living them out fits Shimei’s broken oath, but the passage does not present this as the common failing of all three men. In particular, Joab’s judgment is linked to the blood he shed.

“What He establishes, nobody can shake” is too sweeping when applied to Solomon’s kingdom. God’s promises are sure, but the kingdom was later divided; His establishment of Solomon did not make that kingdom immune to upheaval.
